verdict.rationale: Braintrust publishes an API reference stating the API lets you interact with all aspects of the platform programmatically, including managing projects, experiments, datasets, traces, prompts, tools, and scorers, with API-key auth shown in the SDK usage. No OpenAPI spec was found at the standard paths probed, which is a discoverability gap but does not contradict that the API exists. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a standard location, independent hands-on corroboration of the REST API, explicit documentation of auth and endpoint details in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Braintrust API allows you to interact with all aspects of the Braintrust platform programmatically.
You can use it to: Create and manage projects, experiments, and datasets; Log traces and metrics; Manage prompts, tools, and scorers
